entries.q.tobacco.current: Ese ubu ukoresha itabi, iryo banywa cyangwa iridanywa (nk'itabi rya sigara, shisha cyangwa iryo bahekenya)?
entries.q.auditc.1: Ni kangahe unywa ikinyobwa kirimo inzoga?
entries.q.auditc.1.opt.1: Rimwe mu kwezi cyangwa munsi yaho
entries.q.auditc.2: Ku munsi usanzwe unywaho, unywa ibinyobwa bisanzwe bingahe birimo inzoga?
entries.q.auditc.3: Ni kangahe unywa ibinyobwa 6 cyangwa birenga mu gihe kimwe?
entries.q.auditc.3.opt.4: Buri munsi cyangwa hafi buri munsi
entries.q.activity.moderate: Mu cyumweru gisanzwe, umara iminota ingahe ukora imirimo yoroheje ituma uhumeka vuba gato, nko kugenda wihuta, kwikorera imitwaro cyangwa gutwara igare?
entries.q.activity.vigorous: Mu cyumweru gisanzwe, umara iminota ingahe ukora imirimo ikomeye ituma uhumeka vuba cyane, nko kwiruka, gukina umupira cyangwa guhinga cyane?
entries.q.diet.servings: Ku munsi usanzwe, urya ibipimo bingahe by'imbuto n'imboga? Igipimo kimwe kingana n'ikiganza kimwe cyuzuye.
entries.q.diet.salt: Ese wongera umunyu ku biryo uri ku meza?
